## Frequently Asked Questions

Can’t find what you’re looking for? [Talk to us](https://www.gushwork.ai/demo)

### What’s included at $900 a month?

$900 is the starting point, with every agent and feature switched on. The plan includes setup, page creation, optimization, tracking, and support to help your business generate qualified inbound leads.

### What changes the final price?

Final pricing depends on how many pages you want published, how fast you want to grow, and how much paid support you add. We confirm your exact number on the call.

### How soon will I see leads?

Most businesses we have worked with so far, see their first set of qualified leads around month 3 to 4, and it compounds from there. The early weeks go into learning your business, finding what your buyers search for, and publishing pages. We won’t promise leads in week one. Search takes time to build, which is exactly why it keeps paying off once it does.

### How much of my time does this take to go live?

Less than 30 days. After a short onboarding, you’re looking at a few minutes a week to review progress. We handle the research, writing, publishing, and optimization. You approve the direction and watch the leads come in.

### Will the content be accurate for my industry?

Yes. The Memory Agent learns your products, buyers, and the way your market talks, so pages read like you, not generic filler. For technical or regulated niches, a human reviews the work before it goes live. You can approve content yourself too, if you want that control.

### Can I choose which agents I want?

Gushwork is not sold agent by agent. It works as one growth platform where the right agents are activated based on what your business needs. You get the full system, and we handle which agents need to run at each stage.
